tool_args.rationale: The supply-bullwhip bridge maps to the inland-hub siphon, but the pilot varies only input and leaves the sink-gradient response unidentified. The open-branch probe directly tests that ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All pilot rows have the same sink gradient, so sink inhibition and the open branch cannot be identified separately.
The supply-bullwhip bridge and flux-conservation signatures point first to the static siphon; a trajectory batch is not yet justified.
It does not resolve the identified branch and gradient ambiguity.
